mapper.sql: select u.user_id id, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) name, u.dept_id, d.dept_name dept, coalesce(es.duty_status, 'ON_DUTY') duty_status, coalesce(es.work_status, 'AVAILABLE') work_status, coalesce(active_orders.load_count, 0) load_count, es.current_order_id, coalesce(active_orders.overdue_count, 0) overdue_order_count, coalesce(es.status_source, 'AUTO') status_source, es.last_changed_at, es.last_heartbeat_at, es.update_time, case when es.last_heartbeat_at is not null and es.last_heartbeat_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute) then 1 else 0 end online from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' left join wo_engineer_status es on es.engineer_id = u.user_id left join ( select current_assignee_id engineer_id, count(*) load_count, sum(case when overdue_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end) overdue_count from wo_order where del_flag = '0' and status in ('WAIT_ACCEPT', 'ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING', 'WAIT_CONFIRM') group by current_assignee_id ) active_orders on active_orders.engineer_id = u.user_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_key = 'workorder_engineer' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' )
mapper.insert: insert into wo_engineer_status (engineer_id, engineer_name, engineer_dept_id, duty_status, work_status, current_order_id, active_order_count, overdue_order_count, status_source, last_changed_at, last_heartbeat_at, update_time) values (#{engineerId}, #{engineerName}, #{engineerDeptId}, #{dutyStatus}, #{workStatus}, null, 0, 0, 'MANUAL', #{changedAt}, #{changedAt}, #{changedAt}) on duplicate key update engineer_name = values(engineer_name), engineer_dept_id = values(engineer_dept_id), duty_status = values(duty_status), work_status = values(work_status), status_source = 'MANUAL', last_changed_at = values(last_changed_at), last_heartbeat_at = values(last_heartbeat_at), update_time = values(update_time)
